title: Introducing Automat Document Processing | Automat
summary: Extract, classify, and process documents with AI -- no custom implementation needed. Automat's IDP platform handles invoices, claims, mortgage docs, and more.
body_markdown:
Today, we're thrilled to announce the launch of **Automat's Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) Platform** —a powerful new way for teams to extract, classify, and process documents without waiting for custom implementations or dedicated engineering support.


For years, intelligent document processing has required lengthy setup cycles, complex integrations, and ongoing maintenance that only the largest enterprises could afford. We built our platform to change that. Now, operations teams across banking, mortgage, insurance, healthcare, and e-commerce can deploy production-ready document automation in hours—not months.
‍


### **Document Studio and Instant API Access**


At the heart of this launch is **Document Studio** —our intuitive web interface where you can upload sample documents, define extraction fields, and train custom models with zero code. Whether you're processing invoices, loan applications, claims forms, or purchase orders, Document Studio learns from your data and adapts to your specific document layouts.


Once your model is ready, deploy it instantly via API endpoints or trigger workflows directly from our dashboard. Our human-in-the-loop tooling ensures that edge cases get flagged for review, while our adaptive AI continuously improves accuracy based on your team's feedback.
‍


### **Speed, Control, and Scalability**


Traditional IDP implementations can take 3-6 months and require constant back-and-forth with vendors. Our self-serve approach puts you in the driver's seat. You define the fields. You train the models. You deploy on your timeline. And when document formats change—as they inevitably do—you can update your extractors without filing a support ticket.


It's about giving teams flexibility. Start with self-serve for straightforward use cases, then scale up to our enterprise offering with dedicated engineering support when complexity grows. Either way, you're building on the same battle-tested infrastructure that processes millions of documents for industry leaders in financial services and beyond.


‍


### **Who should use this:**


Anyone who wants to stand up a simple document extractor endpoint with minimal setup can use this. It's simple, allows for basic configuration, and gets you up and running quickly. No need to manage schemas, just a simple UI to build them and extractions are available instantly from a REST call.


‍


### **Enterprise-Grade from Day One:**


Self-serve doesn't mean compromising on security or compliance. Every deployment adheres to SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 standards. Audit trails, granular permissions, and real-time monitoring come built-in. Choose cloud hosting or deploy on-premise—we support both.


Our self-healing agents handle exceptions gracefully, retry failed extractions automatically, and route uncertain results to your team for human review. Consistent, reliable document processing that scales with your business.


‍


### **Get Started Today**


Ready to see what self-serve IDP can do for your operations? Visit[idp.runautomat.com](https://idp.runautomat.com/) to explore the platform, or reach out to our team at **runautomat.com/contact** to discuss your specific use case.
